\subsection{CVE relevance filters and OWASP mapping}\label{app:cve-lexicon}
All patterns are case-insensitive Python regular expressions applied to the English description concatenated with the record's CPE match strings. A record is \emph{Tier~1} if it matches any Tier-1 pattern, \emph{Tier~2} if it matches a Tier-2 framework pattern \emph{and} the ML-context pattern, and it is discarded if it matches the deny-list. All rules were written by hand; no language model was used to label or map CVEs.

\textbf{OWASP Top~10 for LLM Applications (2025).} A CVE is assigned every category whose description pattern matches or whose CWE set intersects the record's CWEs; Tier-2 records with no match default to LLM03.\par
